figurative_meaning_en: At least one person or someone inevitably
example_sentences_in_bangla: একজন না একজন তো যাবেই পার্টিতে।
কাজটা একজন না একজন করে ফেলবে।
example_sentences_in_english: One or the other will definitely go to the party.
Someone or other will get the job done.
note: This idiom emphasizes inevitability in group contexts, common in colloquial Bengali.
